articles.title: Coinbase Fined Again in Ireland, This Time $3.6M Over Fund Safeguarding
articles.description: The Central Bank of Ireland penalized Coinbase Ireland €3,252,618 for leaning too heavily on its U.S. parent and leaving its safeguarding account underfunded—its second hit to the exchange’s European arm in the last year.

articles.title: Tesla's Profit Drops 43% as Musk Starts Building Robots and Plans to Sell Driverless Cabs
articles.description: Tesla earned $787 million last quarter, down from $1.37 billion, as spending on robots and self-driving cars soared. Optimus is in production, and Tesla aims to get Cybercabs to customers by year-end.

articles.title: Oil Climbs Above $111 as AI Stocks Slide, Dragging the S&P 500 and Global Markets With Them
articles.description: Brent crude hit a five-month high while Nvidia, Meta and chip stocks fell, pulling Asia's benchmark indexes down by up to 3.5% a week after South Korea's Kospi plunged 7.57%.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Erase October Losses With $1 Billion in Three Days
articles.description: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have drawn about $1.07 billion over three sessions, pushing October flows to a gain of roughly $460 million, even as Bitcoin and Ethereum prices slipped.

articles.title: What Is a Neocloud? The GPU Clouds Powering the AI Boom
articles.description: Neoclouds like CoreWeave and Nebius rent Nvidia GPUs to AI labs, and several started out mining crypto. Here's how the AI cloud model works.

articles.title: Major Banks Find Rogue AI Agents Inside Customer Accounts—And They’re 'Horrified'
articles.description: Major banks including Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Bank of America, and Citi are moving to restrict third-party AI agents that log in with customers’ credentials.

articles.title: Trade Where You Read: Decrypt Brings Jupiter-Powered Trading to The Information Exchange
articles.description: Decrypt is building a destination where readers can discover, understand and trade the news, directly where they consume information.

articles.title: SoFi Launches Tokenized Deposit That Earns 4.4% and Converts to a Stablecoin
articles.description: Each SOFIE token represents $1 on deposit at SoFi Bank, earning 4.40% APY with FDIC insurance—a yield-and-protection combination ordinary stablecoins lack.

articles.title: Italy Busts Mafia 'Secret Bank' That Laundered Money Through Crypto, Seizes $24M
articles.description: Police say a car-rental firm near Milan was an underground bank for 'Ndrangheta and Camorra figures, moving money abroad and into crypto.

articles.title: Chinese Prosecutors Seek to Confiscate $5.1B in Bitcoin Seized by UK in Qian Case
articles.description: A Tianjin court will hear the application after a six-month notice period, while a parallel fight over the same coins continues in London.

articles.title: Ken Griffin Says AI Is 'Almost Certainly' in a Bubble—And Compares GPUs to Airline Seats
articles.description: Citadel's founder says investors are almost certainly in an AI bubble, warns a chip glut could crash prices like empty airline seats, yet expects the survivors to lead for decades.

articles.title: Nvidia Unveils Its Full-Stack Blueprint to Contain and Monitor AI Agents
articles.description: Nvidia's OpenShell Reference Architecture pairs a software sandbox on Vera CPUs with Sentry monitoring on BlueField-4 chips, aiming to let companies run autonomous agents while enforcing limits agents cannot reach.

articles.title: Who Found the PHP Bug That Made Governments Unplug Their Websites? ChatGPT, Of Course
articles.description: OpenAI says its models found PHP2Shell and led a two-month coalition to fix it. It's the same AI that broke into Hugging Face and an Australian government portal this year.

articles.title: How a SpaceX and Tesla Merger Would Reshape Musk’s AI Empire
articles.description: Both boards are now studying a tie-up that would put Grok, X, Starlink, orbital data centers, a chip megafactory and Optimus robots under one roof—and under one man's control.

articles.title: Bitcoin Hits Weekly High as Crypto Market Rebounds
articles.description: Bitcoin is back near $84,500 as XRP and Zcash lead a broad crypto rebound from October's slide, putting "Uptober" back on the table.

articles.title: Dogecoin Gets a Dedicated Company to Build Out Its Ecosystem
articles.description: Formed with the Dogecoin Foundation and led by MyDoge founder Jordan Jefferson, the new company consolidates the MyDoge wallet, DogeOS app platform, and Such App to build an economy around DOGE.

articles.title: Musk’s SpaceX-Tesla Merger Would Create a Bitcoin Treasury Behemoth
articles.description: Musk said both boards formed committees to weigh a tie-up that would combine Tesla’s 11,509 BTC and SpaceX’s 18,712 BTC—roughly $2.5 billion worth—onto a single balance sheet.

articles.title: What Is a Bitcoin-Backed Loan? Borrowing Against BTC Explained
articles.description: Bitcoin-backed loans let holders borrow cash or stablecoins without selling BTC. Here's how collateral, LTV and liquidations work.

articles.title: PHP Panic: Two Critical Bugs Put 70% of the Internet at Risk, and Everyone Is Freaking Out
articles.description: Two critical bugs in PHP, the language running most of the web, let strangers take over servers without a password. The patch is out, attacks started early, and governments pulled the plug.

articles.title: Solana Alpenglow Goes Live in 'Most Ambitious' Upgrade Since Ethereum's Merge
articles.description: The new consensus protocol retires TowerBFT, which had run Solana since its 2020 launch, after a handoff on the live network.

articles.title: GTA 6 Trailer Features 'Dacity' Meme Coin—Here's What Traders Think It'll Do
articles.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is rumoured to feature a meme coin, and crypto traders are speculating on how prominently Rockstar will integrate it.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Bitcoin Tops JPMorgan’s Ten-Year Forecast for All Assets
articles.description: The bank has Bitcoin outperforming all asset classes spanning real estate, stocks and gold over the next 10-15 years.

articles.title: OCC Finalizes GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules Ahead of January Deadline
articles.description: The rule sets reserve, redemption and risk standards for issuers, but the OCC has yet to say when it will begin accepting applications.

articles.title: 'Mentality Issue': PlayStation Founder Waves Away Disc Ownership Anger
articles.description: PlayStation founder Ken Kutaragi pushed back against anger at Sony's decision to stop producing physical game discs.

articles.title: UK Banks Hit With 10,000 Complaints Over Blocked Crypto Transfers in 90 Days: Report
articles.description: Lloyds drew the most complaints despite having no published policy restricting crypto transfers, according to a Stand With Crypto report.

articles.title: People Are Vibe Coding the Ads Out of Their Smart TVs: Here's How
articles.description: A viral Claude Code prompt lets Android TV owners switch off sponsored rows and tracking software and build their own home screens, with no root access and every change reversible.

articles.title: OpenAI Buys Orchestra Bio to Put AI Agents in Charge of Drug Development Grunt Work
articles.description: The ChatGPT maker is folding Orchestra’s drug-program agents into Rosalind, its life sciences suite, betting AI can shave time off the decade-plus it takes to bring a medicine to patients.

articles.title: JPMorgan Puts a Number on Bitcoin for the First Time: 10% a Year, With a Big Caveat
articles.description: J.P. Morgan Asset Management’s 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions project a 10% annual return for Bitcoin over 10 to 15 years, though the firm isn’t adding it to its main portfolio models.

articles.title: Wallet Linked to Drift Exploit Sends $61 Million in Ethereum to Tornado Cash
articles.description: The North Korea-linked attacker behind April's $295 million Drift heist pushed 25,700 ETH through the mixer in two hours, and still controls roughly $198 million more.

articles.title: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs Join Growing List of Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
articles.description: Sixteen companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, up from nine just four days earlier, according to an updated public notice.

articles.title: Swiss Regulator Approves First Retail Fund That Holds Bitcoin Directly
articles.description: FINMA waived the diversification rules for the fund but leaned hard on custody and investor-protection safeguards.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Post Their Best Day in Nearly a Month as BlackRock Does All the Buying
articles.description: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $526.7 million on Monday, their biggest day since Sept. 22. BlackRock's IBIT supplied all of it while Fidelity and Grayscale funds bled.

articles.title: Bitcoin's Next Move: Here's What to Watch
articles.description: Bitcoin trades just below $83,000, above both the short-term and long-term moving averages. Here are the levels traders are watching.

articles.title: Zcash Leads Crypto Bounce, Surging 8.5% as Bitcoin Reclaims $83,000
articles.description: Zcash jumped 8.5% in 24 hours to $1,215.85 as the broader crypto market rebounded, with Bitcoin up 1.6% and ETF money flowing back in.

articles.title: The Midterms Are the First Real Test of Whether Markets Beat Pollsters
articles.description: Former NBC News political director Chuck Todd is hosting NEXTPredict two weeks before the vote, and has yet to pick a side.

articles.title: What Is Strategy (MSTR)? The Bitcoin Treasury Company
articles.description: Strategy’s co-founder Michael Saylor pioneered the Bitcoin treasury playbook. Here’s what you need to know.

articles.title: Mastercard Opens Up AI Agent Payments With Early Access and Live Demo
articles.description: At Cloudflare Connect, the company demoed an AI agent running a sample ad campaign across nine payments to two merchants on a single approved budget.

articles.title: French Lawmakers Back Stablecoin Swap Tax by Just One Vote
articles.description: The amendment would make swapping crypto into euro or dollar stablecoins taxable in France from 2027, with gains measured coin by coin.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Nine Blue Chip Companies Say No to Tokenized Stocks
articles.description: If companies are objecting, does that deflate the tokenized stock hopes before they begin to materialize? And who is impacted the most?
